sentences.text: I told this free AI exactly where to put everything, and it made this.
It's FLUX 3 Klein, the new model from the FLUX team.
You draw boxes, say what goes in each one, and type your idea.
Hit generate, and everything lands right where you asked.
It even writes clean text on signs and posters.
And it's free. It runs right in your browser.
Comment FLUX and I'll send you the link.

caption:
I told this free AI exactly where to put everything 👀

FLUX 3 Klein lets you draw boxes, say what goes in each one, and it builds the image around them. It even writes clean text on signs and posters.
Free, runs in your browser, open weights.

Comment FLUX and I'll DM you the link.

#ai #aitools #flux #aiart #imagegenerator #design #opensource
